set.body:
Portable vocabulary in the document module per ADR 0024 (main 4e689be37) sections 1-2 and owner decision 1. No JVM types and no new module.
- ReferentMention with one origin (visual track or detection, dialogue utterance with its speech context, narration or annotation, recall unit by id) and TypedSupport in the origin's own coordinate family.
- Identity bases with a fixed licence class: sufficient (ContinuousTrack reusing EvidenceAnchor.Track, DeicticReference with exactly one present candidate, NamedReference attached directly, TextCoreference) and contributory (AppearanceMatch, TemporalProximity, CompatibleDescription). Distinctness bases likewise; the S3 review notes duplicate detections, reflections and aliases as guards to consider.
- IdentityLink and DistinctLink: final non-case classes, checked factories taking enough context to prove the relation, Either errors.
- A deterministic resolver from mentions plus links to classes: Resolved only through sufficient links; Open with candidates otherwise; a sufficient DistinctLink opens the class; contributory evidence is recorded and never resolves or opens.
Acceptance: unit tests per law; courts from outside the package (documentprobe) refusing apply/copy/fromProduct/Mirror with same-shape positive controls, clean recompile; mutation kills on each factory check; reference-scope gate on JVM, JS and Native with totals; scalafmt; independent review of the exact SHA.
set.title: [evidence-binding S3a] document: referent mentions, licensed identity and distinctness links, resolver
